entries.name: Hoarded Thresher

counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line (vitality, low) against a grafted rung's normal 1-2 pool draws in the t1-t3 window; the hit-mend and lifesteal riders are resource.delta capabilities, not raw stats, so neither counts toward the ceiling.

entries.notes: ROLE BREAK (generator rule, not a machine rule): atom.vitality's legal role list (g-life.json) is head-guard/sense/core-guard/mantle/footing/girdle/jewel-major/jewel-minor-a/b/armament-secondary — it excludes armament-primary. A rolled muzzle would never draw a raw maxHp stat; this one carries it fixed, because a spitter that shrugs off return fire is the entire point of the item. atom.hit-mend (roles include armament-primary) and the atom.lifesteal variance slot (same) are both pool-legal for this role, so only the raw-stat line is the deliberate break. RUNTIME HONESTY: both hit-mend and lifesteal are resource.delta kind, lawn-live and battle-unsupported today per the exemplar's own disclosure — this item works on the lawn and rejects in battle until battle grows a grant path for that kind. baseType resolves to the sibling base-type partition's plant-muzzle-b file (role armament-primary, band b). Name is pattern 'compound': 'hoarded' from themeAdjectivePools['ember-harvest'], 'thresher' from nounPools['armament-primary.plant'].

entries.name: Stalk of the Reaping

counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line (fortitude, low) against a cultivated rung's normal 2-3 pool draws in the t1-t3 window; the fixed core is three atoms (base type implicit + these two) inside the cap of 4, one variance slot means pool_rolls = 1.

entries.notes: ROLE BREAK: atom.entangling's legal roles (g-affliction.json) are armament-primary/armament-secondary/manipulator/jewel-major/jewel-minor-a/b/sense — core-guard is not among them, so no rolled stem could ever draw a snare. Fixed here because a stem that roots the thing that strikes it is the item's whole concept. atom.fortitude and the atom.stalwart variance slot are both pool-legal for core-guard, so the control rider is the only deliberate break. RUNTIME HONESTY: atom.entangling's own family notes flag status:"kelp" as DECLARED INERT today (StatusPayloadKind.UnityCc with no Unity branch wired) — this item imports and prices cleanly but the snare does not bind anything until that branch ships. Name is pattern 'of-construct': base 'Stalk' from nounPools['core-guard.plant'], concept 'Reaping' (with 'the') from conceptPools['ember-harvest'].

entries.notes: ROLE BREAK: atom.gravedigging's legal roles (g-board.json) are retinue/jewel-major/jewel-minor-a/b only — ward-array is not among them, and none of the plant-legal ward-array families in this corpus (the shield-stat group) carry a board-utility capability at all. Fixed here anyway: a sheath that clears the grave that would otherwise clog the lane it stands in is the item's utility hook, tagged 'utility' on the family itself (g-board.json). atom.shield-capacity and the atom.shield-toughness variance slot are both pool-legal for ward-array (g-shield-stat.json). RUNTIME HONESTY: per atom.econ-bounty's own family notes, its write path (board.thePoints) is real and tested but has no confirmed downstream consumer today — authored anyway because the write path itself works and a kill-tally is exactly the judgement seed-contract.md §8 says a formula can never recover later. Name is pattern 'fusion': whole-token atomic word 'Warmthkeeper' from uniqueSetSeedPools['ember-harvest'] (rule 2a resolves it as a single registered word, not decomposed).
